messages.subject: Re: Line breaks in axis labels etc
messages.subject_clean: Line breaks in axis labels etc
messages.body_plain:
Hey,

Just wondering if you figured this out. I'm trying to pass HTML tags to an axis title, but they won't render properly. e.g.

ggvis(data.frame(v=rnorm(100)), ~v) %>%
layer_histograms() %>%
add_axis("x", title="Volume (m<sup>3</sup>/ha)")

Thanks,
Fabio

On Thursday, February 5, 2015 at 9:42:28 PM UTC-2, Peter Ellis wrote:
> Is it possible to have line breaks in axis labels?  For example, in the minimal example below, I want the "A very long title\nI want to break" to break into two lines after title, but at some point ggvis has cleaned out the '\n' from the string and it is just ignored.  Thanks.
>
> library(ggvis)
>
>
> break_eg <- data.frame(
>    Subject = c("A very long title\nI want to break", "Foo"),
>    Value = c(5,6)
>    )
>
>
> break_eg %>%
>    ggvis(x = ~Value, y = ~Subject) %>%
>    layer_points()
>
>  <https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/-Ml_dpercFZc/VNP_WGy62jI/AAAAAAAAAJs/ivUBLie1-3Q/s1600/linebreak_eg.png>
>
>
>

messages.body_plain:
Hi – no, I don’t think it’s moved on from when I had the initial request.  It is a known issue in the backlog, but development seems to have gone on ice with ggvis from Hadley and co, and I don’t have the time (or quite the right skills) to hop in and try and fix it myself.

Cheers

PE
